item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: These Villagers Wonder if They’re on the Front Line of Russia’s Shadow War
item.description: Russia is accused of clandestine attacks on Ukraine’s allies in Europe, most notably at Leipzig/Halle airport in eastern Germany. That has changed life for villagers nearby.
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: Japan Attempts to Revive U.S. Steel
item.description: After its fraught takeover of steel maker U.S. Steel, a Japanese manufacturer is attempting to revitalize the American company’s facilities, including its oldest mill outside Pittsburgh.
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: Xi Pitches China as Open Ahead of Trump Meeting
item.description: Bloomberg North Asia correspondent Minmin Low says Xi Jinping’s speech at the APEC CEO Summit offered few surprises, emphasizing China’s stability, openness and credentials as a testing ground for frontier technologies. Xi also touted the resilience of the Chinese economy, saying China would continue to stimulate domestic demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Review: Democrats Claim 56 Senate Seats After Mary Peltola Wins in Alaska
item.description: Ms. Peltola defeated Senator Dan S. Sullivan, a two-term incumbent, to become the first Democrat to represent the conservative state in the Senate since 2015.
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: Rubio Says Rush to Secure Systems May Be Causing Failures
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio suggested the rush to patch systems, whose vulnerabilities are exposed by A.I., may explain recent failures with air traffic controls, banks and government agencies.

item.title: Review: For Democrats, a Leadership Fight Is Marring an Electoral Triumph
item.description: The contest between Senators Chuck Schumer and Chris Van Hollen to be majority leader is sowing party divisions and putting them on public display.

item.title: Review: Trump Asia trip live updates: Trump greets Philippines' president ahead of meeting
item.description: Trump is scheduled this week to participate in the first-ever trilateral meeting with Putin and Xi.

item.title: Review: Asics Steps Up China Push With Goal to More Than Double Stores
item.description: Asics Corp. plans to more than double its China store network and increase local production as the Japanese sportswear maker makes the country a key growth priority for 2027.

item.title: Review: UBS Group Sees Yuan Rising to 6.25 in Most Bullish Market Call
item.description: UBS Group AG expects the yuan to strengthen toward 6.25 per dollar by the end of 2027, matching the market’s most bullish call yet on a currency that has outperformed most Asian peers this year.
